name: What each party is told
statement: Each party receives: the outcome; every rule used, each with its source and credibility label, marking which ones decided the outcome; two to four decisive evidence items; what evidence was missing; whether history was used; and how to ask for a human review of the decision (AUTH-01). Ryde's 30-day limit applies to waiver requests, not to reviews of a FairRyde ruling, so it is not presented as an appeal deadline.
